verses.t: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection
verses.yusufAli: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day
verses.rodwell: It needeth not that I swear by the day of the RESURRECTION
verses.sale: Verily I swear by the day of resurrection

verses.t: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection]
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true)
verses.yusufAli: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil)
verses.rodwell: Or that I swear by the self-accusing soul
verses.sale: and I swear by the soul which accuseth itself

verses.t: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones
verses.pickthall: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones
verses.yusufAli: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones
verses.rodwell: Thinketh man that we shall not re-unite his bones
verses.sale: Doth man think that We will not gather his bones together

verses.t: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips
verses.pickthall: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers
verses.yusufAli: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers
verses.rodwell: Aye! his very finger tips are we able evenly to replace
verses.sale: Yea: We are able to put together the smallest bones of his fingers

verses.t: But man desires to continue in sin
verses.pickthall: But man would fain deny what is before him
verses.yusufAli: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him
verses.rodwell: But man chooseth to deny what is before him
verses.sale: But man chooseth to be wicked, for the time which is before him

verses.t: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection
verses.pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection
verses.yusufAli: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection
verses.rodwell: He asketh, "When this day of Resurrection
verses.sale: He asketh, when will the day of resurrection be

verses.t: So when vision is dazzled
verses.pickthall: But when sight is confounded
verses.yusufAli: At length, when the sight is dazed
verses.rodwell: But when the eye shall be dazzled
verses.sale: But when the sight shall be dazzled

verses.t: And the moon darkens
verses.pickthall: And the moon is eclipsed
verses.yusufAli: And the moon is buried in darkness
verses.rodwell: And when the moon shall be darkened
verses.sale: and the moon shall be eclipsed

verses.t: And the sun and the moon are joined
verses.pickthall: And sun and moon are united
verses.yusufAli: And the sun and moon are joined together
verses.rodwell: And the sun and the moon shall be together
verses.sale: and the sun and the moon shall be in conjunction

verses.t: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape
verses.pickthall: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee
verses.yusufAli: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge
verses.rodwell: On that day man shall cry, "Where is there a place to flee to
verses.sale: on that day man shall say, where is a place of refuge

verses.t: No! There is no refuge
verses.pickthall: Alas! No refuge
verses.yusufAli: By no means! No place of safety
verses.rodwell: But in vain - there is no refuge
verses.sale: By no means: There shall be no place to fly unto

verses.t: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence
verses.pickthall: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day
verses.yusufAli: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest
verses.rodwell: With thy Lord on that day shall be the sole asylum
verses.sale: With thy Lord shall be the sure mansion of rest on that day

verses.t: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back
verses.pickthall: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind
verses.yusufAli: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back
verses.rodwell: On that day shall man be told of all that he hath done first and last
verses.sale: On that day shall a man be told that which he hath done first and last

verses.t: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness
verses.pickthall: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself
verses.yusufAli: Nay, man will be evidence against himself
verses.rodwell: Yea, a man shall be the eye witness against himself
verses.sale: Yea; a man shall be an evidence against himself

verses.t: Even if he presents his excuses
verses.pickthall: Although he tender his excuses
verses.yusufAli: Even though he were to put up his excuses
verses.rodwell: And even if he put forth his plea
verses.sale: And though he offer his excuses, they shall not be received

verses.t: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an
verses.pickthall: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it
verses.yusufAli: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith
verses.rodwell: Move not thy tongue in haste to follow and master this revelation
verses.sale: Move not thy tongue, O Mohammed, in repeating the revelations brought thee by Gabriel, before he shall have finished the same, that thou mayest quickly commit them to memory

verses.t: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation
verses.pickthall: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof
verses.yusufAli: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it
verses.rodwell: For we will see to the collecting and the recital of it
verses.sale: For the collecting the Koran in thy mind, and the teaching thee the true reading thereof are incumbent on Us

verses.t: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation
verses.pickthall: And when We read it, follow thou the reading
verses.yusufAli: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated)
verses.rodwell: But when we have recited it, then follow thou the recital
verses.sale: But when We shall have read the same unto thee by the tongue of the angel, do thou follow the reading thereof

verses.t: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you]
verses.pickthall: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof
verses.yusufAli: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear)
verses.rodwell: And, verily, afterwards it shall be ours to make it clear to thee
verses.sale: And afterwards it shall be our part to explain it unto thee

verses.t: No! But you love the immediate
verses.pickthall: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
verses.yusufAli: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life
verses.rodwell: Aye, but ye love the transitory
verses.sale: By no means shalt thou be thus hasty for the future. But ye love that which hasteneth away

verses.t: And leave the Hereafter
verses.pickthall: And neglect the Hereafter
verses.yusufAli: And leave alone the Hereafter
verses.rodwell: And ye neglect the life to come
verses.sale: and neglect the life to come

verses.t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant
verses.pickthall: That day will faces be resplendent
verses.yusufAli: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty)
verses.rodwell: On that day shall faces beam with light
verses.sale: Some countenances, on that day, shall be bright

verses.t: Looking at their Lord
verses.pickthall: Looking toward their Lord
verses.yusufAli: Looking towards their Lord
verses.rodwell: Outlooking towards their Lord
verses.sale: looking towards their Lord

verses.t: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted
verses.pickthall: And that day will other faces be despondent
verses.yusufAli: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal
verses.rodwell: And faces on that day shall be dismal
verses.sale: and some countenances, on that day, shall be dismal

verses.t: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking
verses.pickthall: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them
verses.yusufAli: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them
verses.rodwell: As if they thought that some great calamity would befal them
verses.sale: They shall think that a crushing calamity shall be brought upon them

verses.t: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
verses.pickthall: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
verses.yusufAli: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit)
verses.rodwell: Aye, when the soul shall come up into the throat
verses.sale: Assuredly. When a man's soul shall come up to his throat, in his last agony

verses.t: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]
verses.pickthall: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)
verses.yusufAli: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)
verses.rodwell: And there shall be a cry, "Who hath a charm that can restore him
verses.sale: and the standers-by shall say, who bringeth a charm to recover him

verses.t: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
verses.pickthall: And he knoweth that it is the parting
verses.yusufAli: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting
verses.rodwell: And the man feeleth that the time of his departure is come
verses.sale: And shall think it to be his departure out of this world

verses.t: And the leg is wound about the leg
verses.pickthall: And agony is heaped on agony
verses.yusufAli: And one leg will be joined with another
verses.rodwell: And when one leg shall be laid over the other
verses.sale: and one leg shall be joined with the other leg

verses.t: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession
verses.pickthall: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving
verses.yusufAli: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord
verses.rodwell: To thy Lord on that day shall he be driven on
verses.sale: On that day unto thy Lord shall he be driven

verses.t: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed
verses.pickthall: For he neither trusted, nor prayed
verses.yusufAli: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray
verses.rodwell: For he believed not, and he did not pray
verses.sale: For he believed not, neither did he pray

verses.t: But [instead], he denied and turned away
verses.pickthall: But he denied and flouted
verses.yusufAli: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away
verses.rodwell: But he called the truth a lie and turned his back
verses.sale: but he accused God's apostle of imposture, and turned back from obeying him

verses.t: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride]
verses.pickthall: Then went he to his folk with glee
verses.yusufAli: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit
verses.rodwell: Then, walking with haughty men, rejoined his people
verses.sale: Then he departed unto his family, walking with a haughty mien

verses.t: Woe to you, and woe
verses.pickthall: Nearer unto thee and nearer
verses.yusufAli: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe
verses.rodwell: That Hour is nearer to thee and nearer
verses.sale: Wherefore, woe be unto thee; woe

verses.t: Then woe to you, and woe
verses.pickthall: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom)
verses.yusufAli: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe
verses.rodwell: It is ever nearer to thee and nearer still
verses.sale: And again, woe be unto thee; woe

verses.t: Does man think that he will be left neglected
verses.pickthall: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless
verses.yusufAli: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)
verses.rodwell: Thinketh man that he shall be left supreme
verses.sale: Doth man think that he shall be left at full liberty, without control

verses.t: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted
verses.pickthall: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth
verses.yusufAli: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)
verses.rodwell: Was he not a mere embryo
verses.sale: Was he not a drop of seed, which was emitted

verses.t: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
verses.pickthall: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
verses.yusufAli: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion
verses.rodwell: Then he became thick blood of which God formed him and fashioned him
verses.sale: Afterwards he became a little coagulated blood; and God formed him, and fashioned him with just proportion

verses.t: And made of him two mates, the male and the female
verses.pickthall: And made of him a pair, the male and female
verses.yusufAli: And of him He made two sexes, male and female
verses.rodwell: And made him twain, male and female
verses.sale: And made of him two sexes, the male and the female

verses.t: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead
verses.pickthall: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life
verses.yusufAli: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead
verses.rodwell: Is not He powerful enough to quicken the dead
verses.sale: Is not he who hath done this able to quicken the dead
